pages.text: Found on the surface level, primarily in the $(item)Crystal Spires$() biome.$(br2)There is no immediate use for it, but we believe it has the compounds to be useful in many chemical processes down the road.
A very sturdy metal.$(br2)Our statistics is a rough estimate right now, but early scans indicate it's found between world height $(primary)0-55$()

Large cluster of $(items)Geodes$(). The dropped $(item)Geodes$() can be broken against hard surfaces to be turned into $(item)Dark Pearls$(). Sometimes the ores also drop $(item)Dark Pearls$().$(br2)The most common deposit in this pocket dimension.$(br2)Early scans indicate it's found between world height $(primary)0-55$()
A Gnarly ore. Seem fit for ritualistic purposes.$(br2)Early scans indicate it's found between world height $(primary)0-25$()
